parsed.notes:
Required Qualifications sets required labels; Preferred Qualifications sets nice_to_have labels. Technologies mentioned only in company descriptions or responsibilities are excluded.
Longer raw_text fragments distinguish required mentions from optional or responsibility-only mentions of the same skills.
Deploying models maps to AI deployment; optimizing inference maps to inference optimization; long-context serving maps to model serving. No unnamed parent skills are added.
Agentic workloads is read literally as experience with agents. Structured outputs is not treated as structured data extraction.
Triton in the CUDA/kernel-engineering context denotes the GPU programming language, not Triton Inference Server, and therefore remains unmapped.
Named numerical formats and transformer-inference bottleneck concepts are retained in unmapped because the qualifications explicitly request familiarity with them and the taxonomy has no exact entries.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
